content:
alex: Hey team — onboarding zephyr-3b. HF origin is `hf://org/zephyr-3b/latest` but the registry mirror didn't pull it. Getting 403 on read from the mirror bucket. Anyone seen this with the new role chaining?
mira: I saw a similar thing last week when the mirror role was missing sts:AssumeRole for the staging account. Which IAM role is attached to the mirror job?
alex: mirror role is `redwood-hf-mirror-role` — I think it should assume `platform-sync-staging`. infra-bot, did the scheduled mirror run for that model?
infra-bot: mirror-scheduler: job 2234567880 started for org/zephyr-3b at 02:12 UTC. Exit code 1. Error: AccessDenied when calling GetObject on bucket `redwood-artifacts-mirror-staging`.
jun: quick checklist: S3 bucket policy + role trust + presign path. Also check origin HF ACL if they set `allow_downstream: false`.
sophie: tokenizer note — zephyr uses sentencepiece and the upstream saved tokenizer has `unk_token: <unk>` but no explicit BOS/EOS tokens. Serving pipeline expects explicit `bos_token`/`eos_token` in model-config. Without those we inject defaults and length-prefill fails. I left a comment on the model-config PR.
alex: ah that explains the failing smoke tests. PR is https://git.internal/redwood/model-configs/pulls/452 — pinged reviewers.
mira: small manifest nit: our manifest v2 validator expects `checksum.sha256` (lowercase) and `size_bytes` fields. Upstream HF was providing `md5` only. We need to compute sha256 on mirror side or reject.
jun: I can add a quick lambda to compute sha256 as objects arrive. It's simple, but we need to decide owner for the change — infra or ingest.
alex: can we do a short cut: presign the upstream HF object and compute locally in the ingest job? presign TTL needs to be long enough for the ingest to download. Any objections?
sophie: presign TTL default is 3600s — that failed when we had slow downloads. For big weights (>10GB) we set `--expires-in 86400`. If you presign from HF mirror glue, make sure presign uses `--part-size`/multipart.
alex: sample presign command I used:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://hf-weights/org/zephyr-3b/weights.pt --expires-in 86400 --profile mirror-ingest
```
mira: after we get sha256 and tokenizer fix, don't forget to validate `dtype` in model-config: some configs say `float16` but our quant pipeline switches to `int8` profiles. Validator should warn if quant profile present and dtype not compatible. Filed a ticket.
jun: PR for the sha256 lambda here: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/898 — assigned to infra-oncall. If infra wants me to move to ingest, I can.
sophie: added tokenizer fallback in the loader: if bos/eos missing, set bos_token = "<s>" eos_token = "</s>" and log a warning + add evaluation baseline.
alex: summary/action items: 1) infra to check role trust for `redwood-hf-mirror-role` (mira/jun), 2) infra or ingest to add sha256 compute (jun infra PR open), 3) tokenizer defaults merged (sophie), 4) model-config PR review + dtype/quant validation (alex/mira). I'll kick off a manual mirror retry once role is fixed. :thumbsup:
mira: sounds good. tagging @oncall-infra for visibility.
alex: thanks — marking this thread resolved for now, will reopen if retry fails.
